the assertion that names HEAD[:12] reddens on the missing-revision branch at reckon/crew/fragment_reconcile.py:150, not on the proximity check at :161 the case is named and documented for, because the fragment it builds never contains the head revision; forcing _nearby to return True leaves all 5 cases green (measured on a scratch copy), and deleting the 'record.summary not in flat' branch at :156 leaves all 5 green too, so two of the module's three stated parts have no guard that fails when they regress

manifest.md:14 records the gate command over both test files, but no log in the run directory records that run: no file carries '12 passed', test_logs (manifest.md:15) names none of it, and the added test file's own five passes are therefore claimed rather than recorded

the module is reachable only as 'python -m reckon.crew.fragment_reconcile' and from its own test; no production call site invokes it, so the delivery-path comparison its docstring promises depends on a reader remembering to run it
